title: Source map and first inspection points
summary: The principal implementation is src/NoSQLServer.cls. Important first symbols include NoSQLServerVersionInfo, DatabaseResult, DatabaseColumn, TableDefinition, DatabaseRow, DelimitedTableStorage, FileDatabaseTable, federated/JSON/SQLite/GeoPackage engines, SQL predicate/expression/parser and transaction/runtime classes. In complete candidate v0.91, inspect src/NoSQLServerSQLiteWritable.cls and native/nosqlsqlitewriter.cpp together; the optional writer is distinct from the original SQLiteDatabaseEngine. GitHub presently includes only the patch intake at autobuild/inbox/20261023T144200Z-CHATGPT-nosqlserver-v091-sync and the complete v0.79 source tree.
procedure: Start with NoSQLServerVersionInfo to establish advertised capabilities.
Inspect the specific engine/provider class before assuming FILE semantics.
Inspect DatabaseResult before writing adapter code so planner/diagnostic evidence is not dropped.
Use current tests matching the feature version as executable evidence.
Verify SHA-256 of the v0.91 complete ZIP before applying patches; do not reconstruct full v0.91 from the GitHub patch intake alone.
